name: opstracking
description: Work with OpsTracking from Claude Code: read projects, tasks, time, clients, assets and invoices; change what you allowed — projects, teams, clients, tasks, time and invoice drafts — always with your confirmation first; and ask for invites, roles and invoice sends that you approve in the app.

url.title: OpsTracking address (optional)
url.description: Your organization's OpsTracking link, e.g. https://amento-tech.neoeasel.com. Leave empty and Claude asks for it the first time you use OpsTracking, then connects in your browser.

token.title: OpsTracking API token (optional)
token.description: Not needed: Claude connects from your browser (run /opstracking:setup, or just ask about OpsTracking). Only for a machine without a browser — a token from Settings → Password & security → API tokens, starting with otk_.

workspace.title: Default workspace (optional)
workspace.description: A workspace name to use when you don't say which. Leave empty to use your first workspace.
